name: Jan Novák
bio:
Jan's journey into motorsport logistics began unexpectedly. While studying engineering at the Czech Technical University in Prague, he volunteered at a local rally event and was immediately captivated by the intricate dance of parts, timing, and personnel required to keep the cars running. He quickly shifted his focus to supply chain management, seeing the potential to apply his technical knowledge to the fast-paced world of racing.

Before joining EVO Racing Team, Jan honed his skills at a smaller outfit, managing logistics for a regional touring car series. He's known for his meticulous attention to detail and his ability to anticipate potential problems before they arise. He thrives under pressure and is a staunch advocate for efficiency and organization. Jan's demanding nature stems from his belief that every element, no matter how small, plays a crucial role in the team's success. 

What sets Jan apart is his uncanny ability to find creative solutions to logistical challenges. He's not afraid to challenge conventional wisdom and is always looking for ways to optimize processes, even if it means implementing unconventional methods. He is a fast worker and dedicated to his role.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight wave
physical.description: Jan is of average height with a lean build.

quirks: Insists on labeling every container, even if it's already labeled.
Has a collection of miniature racing flags on his desk.
Always carries a small notebook and pen, constantly jotting down notes and ideas.
